canva.title: Sleiman Systems – Visual System V1
canva.rule: Use Canva for visual system, covers, UI mockups and reusable layouts. Daily final MP4 is rendered by the internal GitHub renderer so publishing never depends on Canva export or paid AI credits.

explain.rule: Use Explain to prototype process explanations and narration. If no direct MP4 handoff is available, rebuild the winning structure in the internal motion renderer before publishing.

criteria: first frame understood in under one second
target customer or pain immediately clear
hook creates tension via loss, number, contrast, question or surprise
visible motion in first three seconds
proof/demo/value within five to eight seconds

voice_system.rule: Public reels must use the private Ibrahim voice clone. Generic stock TTS is blocked from publishing.
